description:
UI/UX Developer 
 6+ Months 
 Austin, TX 
 Need GC and USC 
 Top Skills: 
 8-10 years of UI/UX development experience. 
 i18n experience. This is a number one priority. Candidates must have i18n experience. 
 JQuery and JavaScript experience. 
 Manager will be looking at the profile to see on the different web applications they have worked on and different companies they have worked for. He looks at Rewards, recommendations, and accomplishments they have received at their previous roles. 
 Must have skills 
 8-10 years of UI/UX development experience. Manager is looking for i18n experience. This is a number one priority. Also, he is looking for JQuery and JavaScript experience. Manager will be looking at the profile to see on the 
 different web applications they have worked on and 
 different companies they have worked for. He looks at Rewards, recommendations, and accomplishments they have received at their previous roles.
 Nice to have skills 
 Framework experience with React and Angular. Design experience with applications on photoshop and Sketch 
 is a nice to have. Providing a URL of previous applications on their resume would be a great value added for the manager.
 Qualifications 
 • 5+ years in UI/UX development 
 • Expert knowledge of JQuery and JavaScript standards including ES6 
 • Experience with HTML5, CSS3 and CSS4 
 • Experience with XML and JSON 
 • Experience with JavaScript frameworks like BackBone, Ember, Angular, and ReactJS 
 • Experience with Node.js, functional reactive programming, and FLUX architecture 
 • Experience with responsive UI/UX development 
 • Familiarity with ICU and other available i18n libraries 
 • Expertise in i18n automation and tools 
 • Good understanding of multi-lingual software development in Agile environment 
 • Experience with GIT and the related optimizations for localization


 If you are interested in the below position please forward your profile to preethib@usmsystems(dot)com or call me on 703 468 0398.
